extracted.name: Milk powder gulab jamun😋
extracted.description: Great recipe for Milk powder gulab jamun😋.
instruction_lines: Make chashni by addin 2 cups of water and 1.25 cup of sugar,once the sugar is dissolved completely add saffron,pinch of cardamom powder and lemon juice to it..let it be hot on low flame..

Take 1 cup of milk powder (i used nido powder) add 1 tbspn of maida,1/2 of baking powder,pinch of cardamom powder mix all togther now add 1 tbspn of clarified butter and 1 egg (make sure egg and butter should be at room temperature) mix well and form a dough!make small balls out of it and fry it in oil on a medium flame till golden brown in colour! Now direct drop those fried jamuns in chashni and close the lid let it cool dwn completly, ready to serve 🤩😋
